feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 11:05pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Mainly dry overnight with clear spells, with a risk of a few spots of rain from a band migrating south of the Isle of Man. Light westerly winds. Minimum temperature 5°C.

Tomorrow brings a fine day with sunny spells and mainly light winds, before heavy rain arrives tomorrow night alongside strengthening winds. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

Heavy rain at first on Friday, bringing a risk of localised flooding, before gradually clearing through the afternoon. Strong northwesterly winds, touching gale force in places for a time. Maximum temperature 12°C.

An unsettled weekend will follow, with gales or severe gales likely to cause some travel disruption.
